📺 9-1-1 (2018–Present)

9-1-1 follows the intense and emotional lives of first responders in Los Angeles as they risk their lives every day to protect their communities and save people facing unimaginable emergencies. At the center of the story is Captain Bobby Nash, a dedicated firefighter who leads the courageous team at Station 118, including Evan “Buck” Buckley, Eddie Diaz, and Henrietta “Hen” Wilson. Alongside them are LAPD Sergeant Athena Grant, a fearless police officer, and Maddie Buckley, a compassionate 911 dispatcher who helps guide people through terrifying situations. From devastating fires and dangerous rescues to shocking accidents, natural disasters, and unexpected emergencies, these heroes must make life-changing decisions under extraordinary pressure. Beyond their demanding careers, they also navigate complicated relationships, family struggles, personal tragedies, and moments of happiness that bring them closer together. Starring Angela Bassett, Peter Krause, Oliver Stark, Jennifer Love Hewitt, Aisha Hinds, and Ryan Guzman, the series delivers thrilling action, emotional storytelling, unforgettable characters, and powerful lessons about courage, sacrifice, friendship, love, and the extraordinary dedication of everyday heroes.

🎭 Genre: Action • Drama • Thriller • Emergency Services

⭐ IMDb: 7.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 43 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creators: Ryan Murphy, Brad Falchuk & Tim Minear

📺 Seasons: 10 (2026–2027 season)

📚 Setting: Los Angeles, California, following firefighters, paramedics, police officers, and emergency dispatchers.

🏆 Awards: Received multiple nominations and recognition for its action sequences, performances, and dramatic storytelling.

📺 Where to Watch: ABC • Hulu (United States)
